violations.type: Custom interactive control missing semantic action
violations.affected_code:
Semantics(
      button: true,
      expanded: expanded,
      label: text,
      excludeSemantics: true,
      child: ... InkWell(onTap: onTap, ...)
violations.explanation: excludeSemantics: true removes all descendant semantics, including the tap action that InkWell contributes. The outer Semantics node declares button: true but provides no onTap handler. Assistive technologies (TalkBack/VoiceOver, switch access) therefore announce a button that exposes no activate action, so the dropdown may not be operable through accessibility services. Fix this by adding onTap: onTap to the Semantics widget, or by removing excludeSemantics and wrapping only the decorative content.
